description: Search the public web using Exa's keyless, rate-limited service by default, or the configured ORACLE_SEARCH_URL JSON backend. Returns source URLs and snippets, not verified page contents. Use web_fetch to verify results. ORACLE_SEARCH_PROVIDER=disabled turns search off.

domains.description: Domains to allow (example.com, subdomains included) or deny with a leading dash (-example.com)

recency.description: Only results published within this window

name: web_search
